newsitem.title: USA: KCS Energy completes new well in Wyoming.
newsitem.headline: KCS Energy completes new well in Wyoming.

text.p: KCS Energy Inc said Thursday it completed another phosphoria dolomite well, which tested at a rate of 881 barrels of oil per day and 3,680 thousands of cubic feet of gas per day.
The new well is in No. 22-12 in the Manderson Field in the Big Horn Basin of north central Wyoming.

The Manderson 22-12 is about 4,000 feet northwest of the Manderson 34-12, the first well drilled by KCS in the field. Data indicates the field is "substantially" larger than the nine-mile length originally estimated, the company said.
